request_summary: Run the approved full GEC DEV integration suite once as fix-04 after the ordering change.

actions.description: Launched the unfiltered GEC DEV Behave suite with isolated fix-04 artifact directories; before_all failed while resolving the configured subscription-key secret.
The orchestrator inspected the fresh console log: exit code 1, zero scenarios executed, 52 scenarios and 403 steps untested; the seven prior failures were not exercised.

outcome.detail: The run produced verified startup-blocker evidence but did not verify the suite or the code change.
